Use the read tool on the image D:\GoatCode-ts\gaia\data\8f80e01c-1296-4371-9486-bb3d68651a60.png and study it VERY carefully (no web tools, no bash).

Answer these exact questions, one by one, with pixel rows if you can estimate them:
1. How many noteheads are in the image? Give the approximate horizontal position (fraction of image width, e.g. 0.31) of each.
2. What is the pixel y-coordinate (top=0) of each of the 5 staff lines? What is the vertical spacing between adjacent staff lines?
3. For each notehead, give the y-coordinate of its CENTER and say whether that center lies exactly on a staff line, between two staff lines (which one), or on a ledger line above/below the staff (state how many ledger lines).
4. How many short ledger lines (partial horizontal strokes) appear in the image, and where (above or below the staff, and near which noteheads)?
5. List the full sequence of staff/ledger lines each notehead touches or is centered on, bottom-to-top numbering where line 1 = bottom staff line, line -1 = first ledger below, line 6 = space above top line etc.
6. Finally state the note letter (A-G) of each notehead assuming BASS CLEF.

Be exhaustive and double-check by describing what you see for each note individually.
